title: Human-approved structured catalog detail layout and conference integration
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 5, 2026 approval to implement the proposed catalog-detail restructuring. Use ARCH-03 as the pilot; define movable, ordered presentation components that reference canonical research units, evidence sections, comparison data, roadmaps, gaps, history, and related topics without duplicating research prose. Remove regional classification and filtering from the public catalog view while retaining actor and source provenance in structured data. Integrate technical findings discovered through Hot Chips 2026 into their canonical catalog topics, remove the conference-specific Pages surface and generic conference links, and retain the conference register only as internal public-information provenance and coverage data. This is an editorial and presentation change over existing provisional evidence; it does not create scientific Consensus, verify vendor claims, enable unattended research, or authorize procurement or adoption.
